messages:
kaya: Heads-up: I'm proposing a small IA change to group Models + Pipelines under a single 'Workloads' header in the left rail to reduce vertical noise. The goal is to make room for a persistent breadcrumb row and an inline quick-actions toolbar. Quick take?

ben: Like the intent. Concern: discoverability for models-centric flows (training, versioning). Can we surface a micro-label or icon when collapsed? Maybe show a monospace shorttype in the crumb like '[M]'.

rachel: Agree on saving space. For breadcrumbs UX: prefer 'Org > Workloads > Models > Short title' with truncation rules and tooltip on hover. Also allow copying a deep-link from the breadcrumb menu.

omar: Router/infra note: we need stable URL contracts. Suggest canonical path `/app/:org/workloads/:kind/:id`. Maintain server-side 301 redirects from legacy `/app/:org/models/:id` to the canonical path to avoid breaking shared links. Client-side should do router.replace to avoid polluting history on redirect.

kaya: Good. On deep-link behavior I want the route to expand the collapsed group and focus the item row but not scroll the page unexpectedly. Prefer subtle 180-220ms ease animation. Also avoid multiple history entries while animating.

ben: Accessibility: when a route triggers expansion, announce with `aria-live=\"polite\"` ("Models section expanded"). Ensure keyboard users land on the focused row and that tab order stays consistent. Also provide a visible skip link when rail is compact.

rachel: Search implications: if Models is no longer top-level, make sure Cmd+K results prioritize model matches and offer an action to open the group. Also update docs/examples that reference `/models/` paths.

omar: Dev plan: I'll implement router redirect middleware and add tests: 1) server 301 for legacy paths, 2) client router.replace for same, 3) ensure animation doesn't create extra history entries, 4) focus lands on target element after expand. I'll add telemetry events `redirect.legacy.models` and `nav.expand.via_deeplink`.

kaya: Nice. UX tasks: I'll update the IA diagram and add a tiny prototype gif showing expand+focus. Ben, can you draft the a11y checklist? Rachel, can you coordinate doc changes and example link list for migration?

ui-bot: Reminder: design review booked Fri 10:30. Add checklist items to the review doc before EOD Thurs.

ben: On it. I'll include keyboard flow, screenreader announcements, and test matrix (VoiceOver, NVDA, ChromeVox).

rachel: I'll compile a migration readme with curl commands for QA and a list of internal docs to update.

kaya: Great, thanks team. If no objections by EOD tomorrow, we'll start the redirect impl and prototype. :thumbsup:
